added_failures_source.note: the reviewed manifest records its two suite observations under key names that are not the manifest-suite contract (log, passed/failed, failing_ids), so review.annotate_review_of_run resolves no log path and would render this count unmeasured; the count and ids stored here are the set difference over the two gate logs the manifest actually names, computed with the module's own added_failures_from_gate_logs, whose positive control (same call, head arm = logs/negative-control-red.log) returns 1 for the added case.

findings.text: the landing paragraph claims the gate's own two files are byte-identical from bdada7e5 to the node head, but the node's own commit 3e1a0066 modifies tests/test_dispatch_records_the_pace_row.py, one of those two files; the identity holds only to the dispatch base a4525840, and the same sentence is repeated in the archive record at docs/evidence/archive/a-window-paces-the-lane-landed.html:2848.

failure_attribution cites promotion.py line 1100 as where the replay keeps only result.returncode; line 1100 is check=False and the read is at promotion.py:1107, so the one citation that locates the output-discarding defect sends a reader to the wrong line.

the module_file header names the node's worktree while the command recorded at line 8 runs env -C /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon, which resolves reckon from the main checkout (the shared venv's editable path has named that checkout since 2026-09-24); the field that exists to certify which tree was measured contradicts its own command.

the suite observations are recorded as log/passed/failed/failing_ids and omit completed/failure_count/failure_ids, and after_suite also omits command, none of which are the manifest-suite contract names; ledger.suite_observation_missing_fields reports four to five missing fields per observation and review.py:_gate_log_path resolves no log, so a measured green reads as unmeasured to every consumer, and any future promotion of a run whose recorded suite_command is set would be refused on it.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against the dispatch base a4525840; three files, +99 lines, no deletions, the cumulative evidence record spliced rather than rewritten.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names one invocation over tests/test_pace_replay.py and tests/test_dispatch_records_the_pace_row.py at four revisions; the manifest records that invocation, its exit status and its log for each, and the gate result reproduces in a scratch tree (23 passed, exit 0 at ef6ec8eb).
item_verdicts.goal: the node was dispatched to show the pace gate green at main with the reserve refusal exercised; the diff adds tests/test_dispatch_records_the_pace_row.py:596 and the manifest records the gate green at its head.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; it reports status complete, two commits, a declared negative control and both suite observations, but records the suites under key names no reader of the manifest-suite contract resolves.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares three exclusive paths; git diff a4525840..ef6ec8eb in the node worktree touches exactly those three files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the added case at tests/test_dispatch_records_the_pace_row.py:596 fails when the refusal is removed, as the node's own negative control shows (DID NOT RAISE CrewError, 1 failed, 22 passed); it couples to the refusal message wording, which is production text at reckon/crew/reserve.py:203.
justifications.evidence: the gate result is recorded and reproducible and the negative control at logs/negative-control-red.log reddens exactly the added case, but the header of logs/repro-main-checkout-d1252a0a.log names a different tree from the one its own recorded command resolves, so part of the evidence does not certify what it claims.
justifications.fit: the case follows the file's existing shape (module-level CONFIG, the host fixture, _plant_receipt and _dispatch), and its name and docstring at tests/test_dispatch_records_the_pace_row.py:596 state the mechanism with no plan or tracker identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the added case at tests/test_dispatch_records_the_pace_row.py:596 exercises the refusal the node was sent to cover, and the headline claim of a green gate reproduces independently: 23 passed, exit 0 at ef6ec8eb and 22 passed, exit 0 at bdada7e5, each re-run in a scratch tree whose module_file named that tree.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat a4525840..ef6ec8eb in the node worktree lists tests/test_dispatch_records_the_pace_row.py, docs/plans/a-window-paces-the-lane.html and docs/evidence/archive/a-window-paces-the-lane-landed.html, all inside the declared write paths, with zero deletions.
